interface.signature: def countVertex(N: int, edges: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of nodes N is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == N - 1 if N > 1 else len(edges) == 0
preconditions.description: The number of edges corresponds to a tree structure (N-1 edges for N>1, 0 edges for N=1).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints are valid node indices between 1 and N.
The list of edges contains no duplicate edges.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(len(S) for S in power_set_nodes if all(any(u in S or v in S for u, v in edges) for _ in [1]))
postconditions.description: The return value is the minimum size of a set of nodes S such that every edge in the tree has at least one endpoint in S.
The result is a non-negative integer.
